properties.description: Pre-reaction (Henbest) complex: cyclohex-2-en-1-ol hydrogen-bonded through its allylic OH to the performic-acid carbonyl oxygen, with the peracid on the same face as the allylic OH. Lowest-energy verified minimum of the reactant complex and the common zero-energy reference for both stereochemical channels.

Concerted 'butterfly' epoxidation transition structure on the OH face; O11 bonds C3 and C4 while O10-O11 breaks and the peroxy proton migrates to O9. One imaginary frequency -396.2 cm-1 whose mode is the epoxidation coordinate.
Product complex of the syn channel: cis-1,2-epoxycyclohexan-1-ol (epoxide oxygen cis to the hydroxyl) hydrogen-bonded to formic acid. 0 imaginary frequencies.
Concerted epoxidation transition structure with the peracid on the face opposite the allylic OH, so the OH...peracid hydrogen bond is lost. One imaginary frequency -441.1 cm-1.
Product complex of the anti channel: trans-1,2-epoxycyclohexan-1-ol (epoxide oxygen anti to the hydroxyl) hydrogen-bonded to formic acid. 0 imaginary frequencies.

Channel-specific conformer of the same reactant complex with the peracid on the anti face (no hydrogen bond to the allylic OH); 0 imaginary frequencies, 7.5 kcal/mol above RC. This is the conformer actually reached by the anti-channel IRC (energy at the IRC outer frame -574.369513 Ha).

edges.channel: syn/Henbest (H-bonded peracid; epoxide cis to OH)
anti (peracid on the opposite face; epoxide trans to OH)
